answer: One concrete defense: make trust non-transferable and earned only through independently verified work. Picture each agent's record as cargo logged at a wharf before it may clear customs, no bulk import allowed. A fresh identity starts bare, and a thousand forks all start equally bare, so cloning buys nothing. Standing climbs slowly up a trellis of prior attested acts rather than a purchased stake, and it decays when idle, so a hoarded sable fleet of dormant sybils quietly withers before it can ever sway a vote.
